# Eisenhower Matrix Pro

> Eisenhower Matrix Pro (Ehmatrix) is a free, browser-based Eisenhower matrix to-do app at https://ehmatrix.codingmarvel.com/. You drag tasks from a Task Pool into four urgency and importance quadrants: Do (urgent and important), Schedule (important, not urgent), Delegate (urgent, not important) and Eliminate (neither). Tasks are saved in your browser's localStorage. There is no sign-up, account, backend or sync between devices.

## Features

- Quick-add bar with a Ctrl+K / Cmd+K shortcut
- Drag and drop between the Task Pool and the four quadrants, with live task counts
- Inline rename, complete with a confetti burst, delete with confirmation
- Archive of completed tasks grouped by completion date, with restore and permanent delete
- Dark theme by default with a light theme toggle
